result.title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
result.summary: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. On Digits-ImageNet and FFHQ eyeglasses, SAGE combines high-fidelity \textit{reconstruction} (rFID below $2$) with unsupervised \textit{subtype discovery}, recovering the digits better than baselines (probe accuracy $0.950$ vs.\ at most $0.281$) and revealing eyewear types, finer sunglasses styles, and mislabeled images; salient-conditioned \textit{generation} raises Digits-ImageNet subtype accuracy over the unfactorized latent ($90.5\%$ vs.\ $27.7\%$) and diversity on both datasets. On retinal OCT, SAGE's salient space separates three diseases using only normal/disease labels.

AI.brief_summary: SAGE 在冻结表示自编码器的高维空间 latent 中直接学习显著因子与共有内容，并以参考图的显著表示条件化 diffusion transformer 生成新样本，在 Digits-ImageNet、FFHQ 眼镜及视网膜 OCT 上同时考察重构、无监督子类型发现与生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从对比数据集中分离显著与共有的空间 latent 因子」的做法，可能与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、任务必要信息筛选及 latent 内容贡献分配有关，可供核查显著表示能否作为视觉证据筛选或条件信号的借鉴线索。
